first_broken_edge: The native planner permanently rejects an actor-local parasite escape endpoint, but retained hazard ownership re-emits the same endpoint and defers useful combat range and line-of-sight recovery.
repair: Preserve the exact typed native movement rejection through ExecuteNativeActionIntent.
Retire only the exact actor, generation, and destination for endpoint mismatch, unreachable, partial path, or missing MMAP.
Suppress the unchanged rejected endpoint until actor or hazard geometry changes.
Preserve successful and transient movement ownership until measured safety or arrival.
Release useful fallback combat in the same kernel resolution after terminal retirement.
live_acceptance: the first terminal parasite escape rejection reaches actor-local feedback
the same actor, generation, and endpoint do not repeat indefinitely
transient or submitted movement remains retained
combat damage resumes when no admitted hazard movement owns the actor
the completion watchdog records a typed terminal and verified cleanup
the report includes party and per-actor DPS and HPS
